name: Getting the application with focus
goalName: Get the process of the application that currently has focus
goal: To mute an application, I must get the process of it. The distinction of which process to aquire is that it has focus.

approach.text: To get the active window, I used the following source: <<source Jorge Ferreira. (2008, September 22). How do I get the title of the current active window using c#? Stack Overflow. Retrieved February 27, 2025, from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/115868/how-do-i-get-the-title-of-the-current-active-window-using-c>>. However, this returned the window name, not the process itself.
To get the process, I iterate through all the processes and return the one where the main handle matches the active window.

normalLearnings: I can get the active window and its process.
result: As seen in the end result below, the application successfully gets the active window to mute / unmute.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/3nHEMH74y38>>
validation: I tested the feature with many apps and games, all of which successfully muted.
contribution: This feature makes sure the correct window is muted / unmuted.
